questions.def: Future perfect: action completed before a future point.
questions.question: By the time he arrives, we ___ dinner.

questions.def: Past continuous for an intention that wasn't fulfilled.
questions.question: I ___ to call you yesterday, but I forgot.

questions.def: "Used to" for past habits or states.
questions.question: He ___ in London when he was a child.

questions.def: Past continuous: interrupted action in the past.
questions.question: I ___ the report when the power went out.

questions.def: "Going to" for planned future actions.
questions.question: They ___ a movie tonight.

questions.def: Future perfect is needed: will have graduated.
questions.question: By next year, I am going to graduate from university.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous: action started and continues.
questions.question: She ___ here since last summer.

questions.def: "Used to" for past habits.
questions.question: He ___ to the gym regularly before his injury.

questions.def: Second conditional: "were" for hypothetical situations.
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would apologize.

questions.def: Past perfect: action completed before another past action.
questions.question: They ___ the project by the deadline.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous: action started and continues.
questions.question: He ___ the piano for five years now.

questions.def: Reported speech: "will" changes to "would".
questions.question: She said she ___ me later.

questions.def: Present continuous for future arrangements.
questions.question: I ___ Paris next summer.

questions.def: Past perfect: action completed before another past action.
questions.question: She ___ the letter before I arrived.

questions.def: Third conditional: past hypothetical situation.
questions.question: He ___ to the party if he had known.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous: action started and continues.
questions.question: We ___ for the bus for an hour.

questions.def: Past perfect: action completed before another past action.
questions.question: They ___ the match by the time we got there.

questions.def: First conditional: present simple in the if-clause.
questions.question: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay home.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous: action started and continues.
questions.question: He ___ for the exam all night.

questions.def: Present perfect: action started in the past and continues.
questions.question: I ___ him since we were children.

questions.def: Future perfect: action completed before a future time.
questions.question: She ___ the report by tomorrow morning.

questions.def: Past continuous: interrupted action in the past.
questions.question: They ___ football when it started raining.

questions.def: Simple past: completed action in the past.
questions.question: He ___ to the gym every day last year.

questions.def: Future perfect: action completed before a future time.
questions.question: By the time we arrive, the concert ___.

questions.def: Future perfect: action completed before another future action.
questions.question: By the time you arrive, I ___ the report.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous: duration before a past event.
questions.question: She ___ in London before moving to Rome.

questions.def: 'Know' is a stative verb, use 'have known' for duration.
questions.question: I am knowing him since we were kids; he's loyal.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous: duration up to the present.
questions.question: He ___ on the project for six months now.

questions.def: 'Might' expresses possibility; 'will' is more certain.
questions.question: I ___ to the gym later if I have time.

questions.def: Future perfect for completed action at a future point.
questions.question: By next year, they ___ the new stadium.
